1.Products & services (ผลิตภัณฑ์และบริการ)

REVIBE is a curated vintage streetwear brand that sells carefully selected secondhand and vintage clothing. The brand also offers upcycled clothing with modern, colorful designs.

2.History & milestones (ประวัติและหมุดหมายสำคัญ)

REVIBE was created from the idea of combining vintage streetwear with sustainability. The brand aims to make secondhand clothing more attractive to young consumers through colorful designs and carefully curated collections.

3.Goals (เป้าหมาย)

REVIBE aims to make sustainable fashion more accessible and appealing to young consumers. The brand seeks to reduce clothing waste by encouraging people to reuse and upcycle clothing. It also aims to build a recognizable streetwear brand that combines creativity, individuality, and environmental responsibility.

4.Customers & markets (ลูกค้าและตลาด)

REVIBE primarily targets Gen Z and young adults who enjoy streetwear, vintage fashion, and colorful outfits. Its customers value individuality, affordability, and sustainability.
The brand can reach its target market through online platforms, social media, vintage markets, pop-up stores, and collaborations with fashion creators.

5.What makes it different (สิ่งที่ทำให้แตกต่าง)

REVIBE stands out by combining curated vintage clothing, colorful streetwear, and creative upcycling. Unlike ordinary secondhand stores, focuses on selecting unique pieces and giving old clothes a fresh, modern look.

6.Numbers that changed (ตัวเลขที่เปลี่ยนแปลงตั้งแต่ก่อตั้ง)
As a new brand concept, We can track its progress using key performance indicators such as:
Number of clothing items sold.
Number of secondhand garments reused or upcycled.
Monthly sales revenue.
Number of customers and repeat purchases.
Social media followers and engagement.

Happy Grain sells healthy granola made from oats, nuts, grains, and dried fruits. It is delicious, healthy, and easy to carry.
2. History & Milestones
Happy Grain started with the idea of encouraging people to eat healthier food that is convenient for everyday life.
3. Goals
To make the brand well-known, improve product quality, and expand the business in the future.
4. Customers & Markets
Our main customers are students, working people, and health-conscious people. We sell our products online.
5. What Makes It Different
Our products are healthy, delicious, easy to carry, and affordable. We use a variety of grains and dried fruits.
6. Numbers That Changed

1. Products & services
Our company provides premium healthy snacks and craft functional beverages made from natural ingredients, focusing on high quality, convenience, and great taste for daily consumption.
2. History & milestones
Founded as a small passion project, we expanded from local pop-up markets and event booths to building an established online brand identity with strong community engagement across social media platforms.
3. Goals
To become a leading lifestyle wellness brand, expanding our product distribution across major retail channels while maintaining zero compromise on product quality and authentic customer experience.
4. Customers & markets
Our primary target audience includes health-conscious young adults, university students, active professionals, and fitness enthusiasts who value quality, nutrition, and modern lifestyle branding.
5. What makes it different
We bridge the gap between delicious taste and health benefits through artisanal micro-batching, clean ingredient transparency, and strong lifestyle branding that connects deeply with gen-Z and millennial consumers.
6. Numbers that changed
 0 to 5,000+ active community followers across social channels.
 300% growth in monthly sales volume since launching pop-up events.
 Expanded from 1 single core product to a diverse line of healthy beverage and snack offerings.
